title: Option Chain Snapshot Schema
description: Canonical record schema for point-in-time option chain snapshots. Each record represents one option contract at one snapshot moment. SIMULATION-ONLY. No option is executable. No option may enter the equity proposal path. No 0DTE, naked, short-premium, multi-leg, exercise, or assignment workflows. Historical option research requires actual point-in-time snapshots — current chains must not substitute for historical snapshots. Theoretical values must not be represented as executable fills.

event_timestamp_utc.description: Point-in-time snapshot timestamp in RFC 3339 UTC, ending in 'Z'.

available_at_utc.description: Timestamp at which this record became available for model consumption.

snapshot_id.description: Unique snapshot identifier shared by all option records from the same chain capture. Format: {underlying}-{snapshot_timestamp_utc}-{provider_role_id}.

snapshot_timestamp_utc.description: Point-in-time timestamp of the full chain snapshot in RFC 3339 UTC, ending in 'Z'. Must not be a current/live chain substituted for a historical point.

underlying_symbol.description: Underlying equity symbol. Must be one of: MSTR, SPY, QQQ.

underlying_price.description: Underlying equity price at the time of the snapshot.

expiration_date.description: Option expiration date in YYYY-MM-DD format (UTC calendar date).

option_right.description: Option right. Only CALL and PUT are defined. No exotic options.

contract_multiplier.description: Contract multiplier (typically 100 for standard equity options).

exchange_or_composite_source.description: Exchange or composite source for this quote. e.g. OPRA, CBOE, PHLX.

bid.description: Best bid price. May be zero (no bid). Zero-bid handling must be explicit — zero bid is not the same as missing bid.

ask.description: Best ask price. Missing bid or ask prevents executable-fill simulation.

bid_size.description: Best bid size in contracts. Required when the provider supplies it.

ask_size.description: Best ask size in contracts. Required when the provider supplies it.

last.description: Last traded price. Required when the provider supplies it.

volume.description: Daily traded volume in contracts. Required when the provider supplies it.

open_interest.description: Open interest in contracts. Required when the provider supplies it.

implied_volatility.description: Implied volatility as annualized decimal (e.g. 0.35). Required when the provider supplies it.

quote_condition.description: Market quote condition. CROSSED = bid > ask (invalid — must be rejected or quarantined). LOCKED = bid == ask. ZERO_BID/ASK = explicitly zero. MISSING_BID/ASK = not available.

theoretical_value.description: Theoretical/model price. Required when supplied by a pricing model. Marked as THEORETICAL — must never be treated as an executable fill.

theoretical_value_method.description: Method used to compute theoretical_value. Required when theoretical_value is supplied.

point_in_time_snapshot.description: Must be true. This record is a point-in-time snapshot. Current/live chains must not substitute for historical snapshots.

simulation_only.description: Must be true. No option is executable. This record may only be used for simulation research.

point_in_time_snapshot_true.description: Historical option research requires actual point-in-time snapshots. Current chains must not substitute.

no_0dte.rule: expiration_date > snapshot_timestamp_utc date (at least 1 calendar day)

bid_le_ask_when_valid.rule: IF bid > 0 AND ask > 0 AND quote_condition NOT IN ('CROSSED', 'ZERO_BID', 'ZERO_ASK', 'MISSING_BID', 'MISSING_ASK') THEN bid <= ask

crossed_market_reject_or_quarantine.rule: IF quote_condition == 'CROSSED' OR (bid > 0 AND ask > 0 AND bid > ask) THEN data_quality_state must be 'REJECTED' or record must be quarantined
crossed_market_reject_or_quarantine.description: Crossed or invalid markets must be rejected or explicitly quarantined.

zero_bid_handling_explicit.rule: IF bid == 0 THEN quote_condition must reflect the reason (ZERO_BID vs MISSING_BID). Zero-bid handling must be explicit.

stale_quotes_rejected.rule: IF quote_condition == 'STALE' THEN data_quality_state must be 'REJECTED'
stale_quotes_rejected.description: Stale quotes must be rejected under a future frozen threshold profile.

theoretical_not_fill.rule: theoretical_value must never be treated as an executable fill. Simulation outputs must carry the THEORETICAL label.

timestamps_rfc3339_utc_z.rule: All timestamp fields must end with 'Z'.

no_timestamp_substitution.rule: All timestamp fields must remain distinct with documented meanings.

no_naked_short_premium.rule: Naked and short-premium strategies are outside scope. Only long CALL and long PUT simulation may be considered in future phases.

no_exercise_assignment.rule: Exercise and assignment workflows remain outside scope.

no_broker_fields.rule: No broker IDs, order IDs, account IDs, execution IDs, approval IDs, H1 fields, credentials, tokens, or endpoint URLs.
